- Height: 120 centimeters (cm)

These precise measurements were communicated to Adam Smith, who confirmed they were helpful and proceeded with crafting the curtains. The measurements allowed for a tailored fit, ensuring the curtains would enhance the privacy and aesthetics of the space effectively. The communication and collaboration between Li Hua and Adam Smith were instrumental in the successful customization of the window treatment.
